ZONINGLOT DEVELOPMENTAGREEMENT dayofSeptember，2011(this "Agreement"), by and between 10-12 BOND STREET, LLC, a New York limited liability company having an address at 276 North Henry Street, Brooklyn New York 11222 ("Owner"), and LAFAYETTE PARTNERS OF GREAT NECK, LLC, as to an undivided 70% interest & BEN LAFAYETTE LLC, as to an undivided 30% interest, as TENANTS IN COMMON both being New York limited liability companies having an address at c/o Monarch Realty Group LLC, 45 North Station Plaza, Suite 400, Great Neck, New York 11021 ("Developer"). RECITALS: A. Owner is the owner in fee title of certain land, with the buildings and improvements thereon,known as 10-12 Bond Street, NewYork, New York, and identified on the Tax Map of the City of New York, County of New York (the “Tax Map") as Block 530, Lot 62, which is more particularly described in Exhibit A annexed hereto (said land being herein called "Owner's Land"; said buildings and improvements, together with any future replacements, additions or alterations thereto permitted pursuant to the provisions of this Agreement being referred to hereinafter collectively as “Owner's Building"; Owner's Land and Owner's Building, together with any other building or portion thereof hereafter constructed on Owner's Land, collectively, are "Owner's Parcel;' B. Developer is the owner in fee title of certain lands, with the buildings and improvements thereon, known as 8 Bond Street, New York, New York, and identified on the Tax Map as Block 530, Lot 64, which is more particularly described in Exhibit B annexed hereto (said land being herein called “Developer's Land"; said existing buildings and improvements thereon,together with any future replacements, additions or alterations thereto permitted pursuant to the provisions of this Agreement being referred to hereinafter collectively as "Developer's Building"). Developer's Land and Developer's Building, together with any other building or portion thereof here after constructed on Developer's Land, collectively, are "Developer's Parcel." Owner's Parcel and Developer's Parcel are, collectively, the “Parcels" and each, individually, is a "Parcel; C. Developer is also the holder of a 99-year lease with Owner for Owner's Parcel (the “Lease"), more fully defined and described in Section 1.1(P) of this Agreement, of which 92 years of the term remain unexpired as of the date of this Agreement, ; D. Owner's Land and Developer's Land are contiguous along a shared property line for a distanceinexcess of 10linearfeet; E.
